status_definitions.known: O explicitly encodes or discusses materially the same idea, but no direct behavioral measurement of the clean candidate's mechanism/scope was found.
status_definitions.evaluated: O has a direct explicit experiment/evidence record on substantially the same mechanism under a named matched scope.
status_definitions.partially_tested: O has measured or implemented a related adaptation/submechanism, but not the clean candidate's full mechanism or transfer scope.
status_definitions.uncovered: No materially equivalent mechanism or direct test was found in the inspected current O snapshot; generic adjacent infrastructure does not count.

summary.note_on_zero_evaluated: No clean candidate matched an O experiment closely enough in full mechanism and tested scope to call it directly evaluated. The bounded_stage_checkpoint_inheritance result is retained as partial evidence for several checkpoint/tree-search candidates because O tested a narrow width-1-versus-width-3 adaptation, not the external mechanisms in their demonstrated configurations.

comparison_guards: Status applies only to the exact clean candidate mechanism and stated source scope.
An O-adapted failure does not count as evidence against the original external method unless the tested conditions establish that inference.

The rejected O bounded_stage_checkpoint_inheritance configuration is scoped to its three frozen tasks, width-1 versus width-3 construction, one-invocation attempts, recorded executor/model, sandbox, and no-effect conditions; it is not scientist-agent-family or original-method evidence.
O runtime replay is not treated as continual-learning rehearsal; semantic context routing is not treated as neural context gating; generic parallelism is not treated as multi-agent evolution.
No clean exploration state was modified and no comparator judgment was written back to workers.
uncertainty: This is a point-in-time read-only comparison against the named O main SHA. Later O commits or later clean worker artifacts can change a status. Code-search absence was used only as supplementary evidence; durable O design/evidence artifacts are primary.
